source.description: The raw data from which the grid was built.

label.description:
An informative label representing the source of the data. This is meant to be displayed along with the grid
as its title or caption. Typically an abbreviated value type of the data.

description.description: A more detailed description of the source of the data. Typically the full value type of the data.

cols.description:
The column meta information for this grid. Note that this does _not_ include the label as a column.

@see #labelCol

sourceType.description:
The type of the values. In most cases, this will be a more specific type than `any`, If the collection is of
heterogenous value types, it will be a shared type of them all (which may end up being `any`).

_jsonProps.description: For a JSON array of objects/arrays, break out properties as columns.

title:
This implementation of {@link DataGrid} is based on a collection of an value type. There is one row for
each value and one column for its printable representation.

If the collection is a {@link Stream}, the totalSize will return `null` until the stream has been exhausted.
name: DataGrid.Values
